mm7/hnp3re.name: hnp3re
mm7/hnp3re.material: house facade of grey rubble stonework with green moss patches, under a band of weathered wooden beams with a row of pale carved runes along a dark wooden board at the top, with a weathered wooden sill at the bottom, and a broad weathered wooden corner post filling the right edge that the picture border cuts through its middle

notes.2: the rubble stonework and the beams at the left run straight on across the left border with no vertical line, gap or shadow; the wooden post on the right is even weathered wood with no outline
notes.3: copy the composition exactly: a solid opaque dark weathered wooden post, as wide as in the reference, runs from top to bottom along the right edge; it is plain even brown wood running right up to the last pixel column with no outline, groove or dark line; the stonework stops against its left side
